positions.as_written: Start with radiographs for the joint space, the erosions and the alignment.
Add a skyline view, since the patellofemoral joint is involved and is otherwise hidden.
Use magnetic resonance imaging when the question is synovial extent or early erosion.
Assess all three compartments, because loss is symmetrical rather than confined.
Assess the bone stock, because it decides what any operation can hold.
